description: Add export and import functionality for rider profiles including settings, FTP history, and avatar configuration. Enables profile backup and transfer between installations.

phases.name: Export Data Structures
phases.description: Define the export format data structures following the LeaderboardExport pattern

subtasks.title: Create ProfileExport struct with versioned format
subtasks.description: Create the main export container with export_version, exported_at timestamp, and profile data. Follow the pattern from LeaderboardExport struct.
subtasks.notes: Created ProfileExport struct with versioned format following LeaderboardExport pattern. Includes ProfileData, FtpHistoryEntry, and AvatarExport structs. Added unit tests for serialization.

subtasks.title: Create ProfileData struct for core profile fields
subtasks.description: Define ProfileData struct containing display_name, bio, ftp, total_distance_km, total_time_hours, sharing_enabled. Ensure Serialize/Deserialize derives.
subtasks.notes: ProfileData struct was already created as part of T001. Verified the struct contains all required fields: display_name (String), bio (Option<String>), ftp (Option<u16>), total_distance_km (f64), total_time_hours (f64), sharing_enabled (bool). Has proper Serialize/Deserialize derives from serde.

subtasks.title: Create FtpHistoryEntry struct for FTP records
subtasks.description: Define FtpHistoryEntry with ftp_watts, method, confidence, detected_at, accepted fields. Match the ftp_estimates table schema.
subtasks.notes: FtpHistoryEntry struct was already created as part of T001. Verified the struct contains all required fields matching the ftp_estimates table schema: ftp_watts (u16), method (String), confidence (String), detected_at (DateTime<Utc>), accepted (bool). Has proper Serialize/Deserialize derives from serde. Tests exist in test_profile_export_with_ftp_history that exercise the struct.

subtasks.title: Create AvatarExport struct for avatar configuration
subtasks.description: Define AvatarExport with jersey_color, bike_style, jersey_secondary, helmet_color. Compatible with existing AvatarConfig from world/avatar.rs.
subtasks.notes: AvatarExport struct was already created as part of T001. Verified the struct contains all required fields matching AvatarConfig from world/avatar.rs: jersey_color (String hex format), bike_style (String), jersey_secondary (Option<String>), helmet_color (Option<String>). Uses portable string formats (hex colors, string enums) for JSON compatibility instead of raw [u8;3] arrays and enum types. Has proper Serialize/Deserialize derives from serde. Test exists in test_profile_export_with_avatar that exercises the struct.

subtasks.title: Create ImportResult and conflict resolution types
subtasks.description: Define ImportResult with success status, conflicts list. Create ProfileConflict enum for handling existing profile data. Follow LeaderboardExporter.ImportResult pattern.
subtasks.notes: Implemented ProfileImportResult struct with success status, import counts (ftp_entries_imported, ftp_entries_skipped), update flags (profile_updated, avatar_updated), and conflicts list. Created ProfileConflict enum with DisplayNameMismatch, ExistingProfile, FtpMismatch, and AvatarMismatch variants. Added ConflictResolution enum with Replace, Merge, Skip strategies. Follows LeaderboardExporter.ImportResult pattern. Added 4 unit tests for the new types.

subtasks.title: Create ProfileExportError enum
subtasks.description: Define error types for export operations: DatabaseError, SerializationFailed, ParseError, ProfileNotFound, InvalidVersion. Use thiserror for derives.
subtasks.notes: Created ProfileExportError enum with thiserror derives. Includes 5 error variants: DatabaseError, SerializationFailed, ParseError, ProfileNotFound, InvalidVersion. Added 6 unit tests for error type verification. Follows pattern from leaderboards/export.rs. Commit: 967a4c7

phases.name: Export Implementation
phases.description: Implement the ProfileExporter service with database queries and serialization

subtasks.title: Create ProfileExporter struct with database connection
subtasks.description: Create ProfileExporter struct holding Arc<Database>, matching the pattern from LeaderboardExporter.
subtasks.notes: Created ProfileExporter struct following LeaderboardExporter pattern. Added Arc<Database> field, new() constructor, and database() getter. Commit: aed6031

subtasks.title: Implement build_export method to gather profile data
subtasks.description: Query riders table for profile data, ftp_estimates for FTP history, and avatars table for avatar config. Combine into ProfileExport struct.
subtasks.notes: Implemented build_export method on ProfileExporter that queries: riders table for profile data, ftp_estimates table for FTP history (ordered by detected_at DESC), and avatars table for avatar configuration. Combines all data into ProfileExport struct. Follows LeaderboardExporter pattern. Added rusqlite import and FtpHistoryEntryRow helper struct. Commit: e243780

subtasks.title: Implement export_json method
subtasks.description: Serialize ProfileExport to pretty-printed JSON string. Handle serialization errors appropriately.
subtasks.notes: Implemented export_json method on ProfileExporter following LeaderboardExporter pattern. Method calls build_export() to gather profile data, then serializes to pretty-printed JSON using serde_json::to_string_pretty(). Serialization errors are mapped to ProfileExportError::SerializationFailed. Added 3 unit tests for JSON format verification, optional field handling, and error type validation. Commit: 5be99a1

subtasks.title: Implement export_to_file method
subtasks.description: Write exported JSON to a file at specified path. Create parent directories if needed. Return path on success.
subtasks.notes: Implemented export_to_file method on ProfileExporter that writes exported JSON to a file at the specified path. Creates parent directories if they don't exist using std::fs::create_dir_all. Returns PathBuf on success. Added IoError variant to ProfileExportError for file I/O error handling with descriptive error messages. Added 2 unit tests for IoError variant. Commit: 2409be0

subtasks.title: Add module export to social/mod.rs
subtasks.description: Add pub mod export; to social/mod.rs and re-export key types (ProfileExporter, ProfileExport, etc.).
subtasks.notes: Added pub mod export; to social/mod.rs and re-exported all key types: ProfileExporter, ProfileExport, ProfileData, FtpHistoryEntry, AvatarExport, ProfileImportResult, ProfileConflict, ConflictResolution, ProfileExportError. Follows the same pattern as leaderboards/mod.rs. Commit: 13edc69

phases.name: Import Implementation
phases.description: Implement profile import with conflict detection and resolution

subtasks.title: Implement parse_import method for JSON parsing
subtasks.description: Parse JSON string to ProfileExport struct. Validate export_version compatibility. Return structured errors for invalid data.
subtasks.notes: Implemented parse_import method on ProfileExporter that: (1) Parses JSON string to ProfileExport struct using serde_json::from_str with error mapping to ProfileExportError::ParseError, (2) Validates export_version compatibility via validate_version helper method (exact match to CURRENT_VERSION "1.0"), (3) Returns ProfileExportError::InvalidVersion with expected/found fields for incompatible versions. Added 8 unit tests covering valid JSON parsing, malformed JSON, missing fields, version validation, empty history, full data parsing, and type errors. Commit: f97822f

subtasks.title: Implement detect_conflicts method
subtasks.description: Check if imported profile conflicts with existing profile (same rider_id, display_name collision). Return list of ProfileConflict items.
subtasks.notes: Implemented detect_conflicts method on ProfileExporter that checks for conflicts between an imported profile and existing profiles in the database. Checks for: (1) ExistingProfile - profile with same rider_id exists, (2) DisplayNameMismatch - imported name differs from existing profile, (3) FtpMismatch - FTP values differ, (4) AvatarMismatch - avatar configuration differs. Also handles display_name collision detection for different rider_ids. Added helper methods query_existing_profile and find_rider_by_display_name. Includes 12 unit tests for conflict type creation and detection logic. Commit: c8a1707

subtasks.title: Implement import_profile method with merge strategy
subtasks.description: Import profile data to database. Support strategies: Replace (overwrite), Merge (combine FTP history), Skip. Update riders, ftp_estimates, avatars tables.
subtasks.notes: Implemented import_profile method on ProfileExporter with three conflict resolution strategies: Replace (overwrite existing data), Merge (combine FTP history with deduplication), and Skip (return immediately). Added database operations for riders, avatars, and ftp_estimates tables. Includes 15 unit tests for import result structures and validation. Commit: da59e1f

subtasks.title: Implement import_from_file method
subtasks.description: Read file contents, parse JSON, and import with specified conflict resolution. Return ImportResult with summary.
subtasks.notes: Implemented import_from_file method on ProfileExporter that reads file contents, parses JSON using parse_import, validates version, and imports profile data with specified conflict resolution strategy. Returns ProfileImportResult with summary. Added 7 unit tests for file I/O error handling, JSON parsing, version validation, and path type flexibility. Commit: e3db026

subtasks.title: Handle FTP history deduplication during import
subtasks.description: When importing FTP history, skip duplicate entries based on detected_at timestamp. Track imported vs skipped counts.
subtasks.notes: FTP history deduplication was already implemented as part of T014. The import_ftp_history_merge method checks for duplicates using detected_at timestamp via ftp_entry_exists SQL query. Tracks ftp_entries_imported and ftp_entries_skipped counts in ProfileImportResult. Existing tests verify functionality. No new code needed.

phases.name: UI Integration
phases.description: Add export/import buttons to the rider profile screen

subtasks.title: Add export button to rider profile screen
subtasks.description: Add 'Export Profile' button to RiderProfileScreen. On click, trigger export and show success/error message.

subtasks.title: Add import button to rider profile screen
subtasks.description: Add 'Import Profile' button to RiderProfileScreen. Open file picker for JSON selection.

subtasks.title: Create import confirmation dialog
subtasks.description: When conflicts detected, show dialog with options: Replace existing, Merge data, Cancel. Display what will be changed.

subtasks.title: Add import/export status feedback
subtasks.description: Show progress indicator during export/import. Display success toast with summary (e.g., 'Imported 5 FTP records'). Show error details on failure.

phases.name: Testing
phases.description: Add unit and integration tests for export/import functionality

subtasks.title: Add unit tests for ProfileExport serialization
subtasks.description: Test that ProfileExport serializes to valid JSON and deserializes back correctly. Test version field presence.

subtasks.title: Add unit tests for import parsing
subtasks.description: Test parsing valid exports, invalid JSON, incompatible versions, missing required fields.

subtasks.title: Add integration tests for export workflow
subtasks.description: Test full export: create profile in DB, export to JSON, verify all fields present. Use test database.

subtasks.title: Add integration tests for import workflow
subtasks.description: Test import scenarios: empty DB import, conflict detection, merge strategy, replace strategy.

subtasks.title: Add round-trip test for export/import
subtasks.description: Export a profile, import it to fresh DB, verify all data matches original. Test FTP history ordering preserved.

subtasks.title: Add module-level documentation for export.rs
subtasks.description: Document the export module with examples, format specification, and usage patterns.

subtasks.title: Add export format documentation
subtasks.description: Create JSON schema documentation for the export format. Include version compatibility notes.

dependencies: src/leaderboards/export.rs - Pattern reference for export structure
src/storage/schema.rs - Database schema for ftp_estimates, riders, avatars tables
final_acceptance: Profile can be exported to JSON file
Profile can be imported from JSON file
FTP history is preserved during export/import
Avatar configuration is preserved during export/import
Conflicts are detected and user can choose resolution
Export format is versioned for future compatibility
All unit and integration tests pass
